resources.string: AndroidMirror uses accessibility to inject touch events from the controller device onto the target device.

📶 WiFi (same network): 1. Both devices on same WiFi 2. Enter the target\'s IP above 3. Tap CONNECT
⚠️ If WiFi fails (AP Isolation): Enable MOBILE HOTSPOT on the target device, connect the controller to it, then enter the hotspot\'s IP.
🔌 USB Tethering: Connect via USB cable, enable USB tethering on the target, enter its IP.
🔌 ADB (computer needed): adb reverse tcp:9001 tcp:9001 adb reverse tcp:9002 tcp:9002 adb reverse tcp:9003 tcp:9003 Enter IP: 127.0.0.1
